title: Machine learning-derived intracellular protein-based prognostic model reflecting a senescence-associated secretory phenotype-driven immunosuppressive microenvironment in lung adenocarcinoma.
summary: The original Methods use NMF, LASSO, random forest and XGBoost with public multi-omics, cell lines, and clinical specimens; Results associate a five-gene SASP-PRS with LUAD survival and inferred immune features. Authors caution treatment-response use is exploratory and calls for prospective/functional validation.
